tutorial.step.intro: Welcome, new foreman! I'm Bolt. Let's save Night Factory No. 3 and finish my rocket in three days. First, I'll show you the old control console
tutorial.step.placeSwitch: Pick the Switch from your inventory and place it on the glowing cell. The switch sends a signal in the direction of its arrow
tutorial.step.placeGear: Next, put the Booster Gear right next to the switch (the glowing cell). It doubles the signal's value
tutorial.step.placeDock: Put the Shipping Dock right next to the gear. The value that reaches it is added to your shipments
tutorial.step.trial: Press Trial Run to watch the signal flow. You can run trials as often as you like
tutorial.step.buyGear: You shipped {score}. Almost at the quota of {quota}! Buy another Booster Gear in the shop
tutorial.step.moveDock: You can drag placed parts around. Drag the Shipping Dock one cell to the right (the glowing cell)
tutorial.step.placeSecondGear: Place the gear you bought in the gap. Double, then double again: ×4!
tutorial.step.commit: You hit the quota! Press the switch (real run) to lock in your shipments. The real run can't be undone, so check with a trial first
tutorial.step.finish: Nice, one rocket part is done! Now build your factory however you like. You can check what each part does in the shop's List or in the Collection on the title screen
tutorial.hint.notReached: The signal didn't reach the dock. Check that the switch, gear and dock face right in a straight line (tap a placed part to rotate it)
tutorial.hint.short: Not at the quota yet. Check the layout and run another trial
howTo.title: How to play
howTo.goal.title: Goal: send Bolt's rocket to space
howTo.goal.body:
Each day has 3 shifts: morning, noon and night. A run is 9 shifts over 3 days
Meet a shift's quota (a shipment target) and one rocket part gets built
Clear all 9 shifts to finish the rocket and launch! Miss a quota and the run ends
After the launch, Overtime lets you see how far you can go: the Moon, Mars, and beyond
howTo.build.title: Building the factory
howTo.build.body:
Buy parts in the shop, then pick them from your inventory and place them on the floor (you get a budget each shift, and leftovers carry over)
Tap a placed part to rotate it, drag to move it. Drag it to the inventory to return it, or to the sell area to sell it (half price)
The switch sends a signal in the direction of its arrow. Each part the signal passes changes its value, and the value that reaches a dock is shipped
Signals that enter an empty cell or leave the floor disappear
howTo.chain.title: Chain tips
howTo.chain.body:
Multiply: gears and presses make values bigger. Stacked multipliers make them skyrocket
Branch: splitters and spreaders make more signals to reach more docks
Retrigger: reflectors and turntables send signals through the same parts again (each part has an activation limit)
Placement: coils and solar panels depend on where they sit. Piggy banks add budget for the next shift
Trial runs are unlimited. Try out a layout before pressing the real switch
howTo.night.title: Night shifts and more
howTo.night.body:
Night shifts have a special rule (low oil, floor repairs and more). You get a preview during the morning and noon shifts
After a run, your records unlock new parts and a bigger factory (see the Collection)
The Daily Challenge is 3 shifts with the same conditions for everyone, ranked worldwide

part.switch.flavor: It never gets less dramatic. Being red does not help.
part.conveyor.flavor: The oldest and most dependable worker in the factory.
part.splitter.flavor: Does two jobs at once, and asks for two breaks.
part.gear.flavor: Beyond rated speed. Warranty expired yesterday.
part.press.flavor: A heavyweight that works harder with friends nearby.
part.barrel.flavor: The shipping form describes it as "precision equipment."
part.junkbot.flavor: Bolt claims it is the same model. The unit denies this.
part.rebooter.flavor: It does not fix things. It makes them move one more time.
part.dock.flavor: The bright exit every chain hopes to reach.
part.merger.flavor: Turns scattered work into one result, using heat and nerve.
part.chainMeter.flavor: Its needle dances with the crowd. Someone erased the maximum.
part.copier.flavor: Some days the copy has more energy than the original.
part.reflector.flavor: The factory's best negotiator: returns every job to sender.
part.turntable.flavor: Never faces the same way twice. It does not know what comes next.
part.oiler.flavor: It says nothing, but everything nearby lasts a little longer.
part.coil.flavor: Matching hums between neighbors reportedly raise output.
part.solar.flavor: Solar equipment assigned to the night shift. Very patient.
part.inspector.flavor: Becomes remarkably diligent only beside a Shipping Dock.
part.piggyBank.flavor: The only asset Accounting cannot locate.
